Moving questions

What do you move?+

Standard household and furniture moves: couches, beds, dressers, tables, chairs, boxes and typical apartment and home belongings. We also load and unload your own truck or trailer.

What can't you move?+

Junk Junkies Texas provides basic household and furniture moving only. We do not move pianos, heavy safes or other extremely heavy specialty items.

How does moving pricing work?+

Moving is billed by the hour based on crew size: 2 movers $150/hour, 3 movers $175/hour or 4 movers $200/hour. Every moving job has a 3-hour minimum ($450, $525 or $600). Stairs are $75 per flight or set of stairs.

What is included?+

Moving blankets and basic plastic/stretch wrap are included. Additional boxes, mattress bags, specialty packing materials and excessive packing supplies may cost extra.

Where do you provide moving services?+

Our Spring location moves households throughout Spring, TX 77373, Klein, TX 77379, The Woodlands, TX and Humble, TX.

Do you also haul junk?+

Yes. Junk removal is what we started with. If you are moving and have furniture or a garage full of things you are not taking, we can haul it away on the same visit.
